events.title: Your desk
events.speaker: The narrator
events.text: In the middle of the room is your desk from Physics. Your name is carved into it in handwriting that is almost yours.

effects.narrate: A first aid kit, and a note: 'you'll need this more than me.' It's signed with your initials.

events.title: The trophy case
events.text: A trophy case full of trophies for things nobody has done yet. One of them has your name. It's for 'Most Likely to Disappear'.

choices.label: Smash the glass
choices.result: Glass cuts, coins spill. The trophies keep smiling.

choices.label: Take the plaque with your name
choices.result: You pry it off and pocket it. Whatever it predicted, it can't now.

events.title: The lunch line
events.text: A lunch line with no students, just trays sliding along by themselves. The lunch lady behind the counter is a hairnet with nobody in it.

choices.label: Take a tray
choices.result: Mystery meat. Somehow restorative. Patti would be proud.

effects.narrate: The hairnet bobs. On the tray: a hall pass with Todd's name and tomorrow's date.

events.title: The frozen aisle
events.text: Rows of frozen sandwiches, each labeled with somebody's name. One is labeled GARY. It's still warm.

choices.label: Smash the freezer
choices.result: The cold in the room drops a notch. The week feels lighter.

events.title: The cold anvil
events.text: An anvil sits in the dark, frosted over. When you touch it, you hear the blacksmith's voice, younger: 'I'm sorry. I couldn't keep it lit.'

choices.label: Warm it with your hands
choices.result: It warms. So do you, a little.

events.title: The empty bed
events.text: A hospital bed with a chart clipped to the end. The patient name is blank. The admitting signature is very clear: Mr. B.

choices.label: Lie down for a second
choices.result: You wake up a minute later, rested, and very sure you shouldn't have done that.

events.title: A comfortable chair
events.speaker: The narrator
events.text: A reading chair and a lamp, in the middle of the Upside-Down. A book lies open on the seat. It's the story so far. It's about you.

choices.label: Read ahead
choices.result: The next page says: 'They read ahead. Rude.' The narrator clears their throat, offended.

choices.label: Close the book politely
choices.result: "Thank you," says the narrator, from everywhere. You feel oddly restored.

events.title: A lost student
events.text: A kid in an old-fashioned letterman jacket sits against the wall. "What year is it?" You tell him. He laughs, then stops laughing.

choices.label: Tell him the way out
choices.result: He walks toward the exit and gets fainter with every step. He waves.

choices.label: Ask who sent him here
choices.result: "The vice principal said I was being transferred."

events.title: A fountain
events.text: The town square's fountain, upside down: the water falls up into the dark. Coins float in it.

choices.label: Make a wish ($5)
choices.result: The water turns warm. You feel lucky. You probably are.

events.title: Your echo
events.text: Somewhere down the hall, someone says your name in your voice. Then they say something you haven't said yet.

choices.label: Shout back
choices.result: Your echo shuts up. Small victories.
